title: EchoMotion: Unified Human Video and Motion Generation via Dual-Modality Diffusion Transformer
author: Yuxiao Yang; Hualian Sheng; Sijia Cai; Jing Lin; Jiahao Wang; Bing Deng; Junzhe Lu; Haoqian Wang; Jieping Ye
summary: EchoMotion is a new model that creates human videos and motion together using a special joint method. It uses a large dataset with videos and 3D human motion to improve the quality and realism of complex human movements. This approach helps make videos where the motion matches the appearance well, allowing flexible and high-quality animation from text or motion inputs.
